title: Onto-CGANS
summary: Onto-CGANS is a research project that embeds ontology (domain knowledge) into a conditional GAN, built on top of the DP-CGANS differential-privacy synthesizer, to generate synthetic data for unseen disease classes such as rare-disease patient records. Its dp_cgans package is an in-tree, modified copy of CTGAN and SDV source (data_transformer, constraints, metadata modules) that also imports rdt and copulas directly for transformers and copula-based modeling, so CTGAN/rdt/copulas from the SDV family are vendored and extended rather than merely called.
evidence: dp_cgans/__init__.py:7-14: 'This package is extended from ctgan and SDV ... Modified the conditional matrix and cost functions'
needs: Notebook/training code that actually invokes the modified CTGAN classes was not present in evidence; confirm the ontology-embedding pipeline runs the vendored CTGAN/SDV code rather than just wrapping it unused.
